headline: Machine learning on public transcriptomes nominates prognostic gene signatures across…
label: Integrative Transcriptomic Gene Prioritization
summary: Public TCGA, GEO and ICGC cohorts paired with ML feature selection continue to yield candidate prognostic and immune-linked gene sets.
synthesis: The dominant thread pairs public transcriptomic resources (TCGA, GEO, ICGC) with machine-learning feature selection to nominate prognostic genes or signatures, usually followed by validation. Examples include a 7-gene RSF prognostic model for gastric adenocarcinoma, a 3-gene EMT-associated signature for prostate cancer metastasis, and a 16-gene macrophage signature centered on LGALS1 in hepatocellular carcinoma. Single-cell designs recur, such as scRNA-seq with bulk integration defining an SPP1 inflammatory tumor-associated macrophage state in NSCLC immunotherapy. Newer items extend the template toward metabolic, microbial, and structural layers, including gut microbial metabolite-host networks in LUAD and KIF11 nominated as a candidate resveratrol target via molecular dynamics. The template is not uniform: the colorectal ICD-derived signature reported non-significant external validation, and the endometriosis study applies consensus clustering to EndometDB.
